d:
In this episode of American Cougar: Revealed, Nat Geo Animals studies cougars' struggles to survive in the severe landscape of the northern Rocky Mountains. A new archenemy arrives--reintroduced wolves competing for game. With data pointing to unprecedented deaths of cougar kittens, big cat wrangler Boone Smith mounts a grueling expedition to track, capture, and radio-collar cougars to study how this species is adapting to a new threat.
